title: Callaway chart adjustment row order update (2, 1, 0, -1, -2)

requirements.summary: Reverse the Callaway grid chart Adjustment header row to 2, 1, 0, -1, -2 for both 18- and 9-hole charts, including shipped defaults and any load-time normalization so older saved charts are migrated to the new order and calculations follow suit.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Admin Callaway Chart Editor, the Adjustment row displays (left-to-right) 2, 1, 0, -1, -2 when charts are using shipped defaults.
When loading a previously-saved chart whose columnAdjustments are in the opposite order (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), the app normalizes it to the new required order (2, 1, 0, -1, -2).
Callaway scoring calculations use the updated adjustment values (i.e., results change consistently with the new columnAdjustments order).

file_operations.description: Update shipped grid-chart defaults so columnAdjustments are exactly [2, 1, 0, -1, -2] for both 18-hole and 9-hole defaults, and update normalization/migration logic so any loaded persisted charts with the previous order [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2] are normalized to the new required order while leaving all grid grossScore/worstHoles cells unchanged.

Ensure the Admin Callaway Chart Editor displays the Adjustment row in the new required left-to-right order by relying on the normalized/shipped chart data (no UI component library changes; do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui).

Verify local-grid-based Callaway scoring calculation paths consume the normalized grid chart columnAdjustments order (2, 1, 0, -1, -2) so computed adjustments/net scores change consistently after the update, without altering any grossScore/worstHoles grid cell values.

Update developer documentation to reflect the new shipped columnAdjustments order (2, 1, 0, -1, -2) and note that older persisted charts in the previous order (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2) are normalized to the new order on load.
